text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! Birthday wishes from you
two
mean so much to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! We're not done yet! Because we... prepared this just for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wait... a V cake?! Oh, that brings me
back! The
Victory Club staff would
always make them for us
on our
birthdays!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And of course, we also have the little
message
plaque too! All that's left is for
you to write your
goal for the year on it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Write down a big dream and then
gobble it up,"
was it? Everyone always
spent ages deciding what
to write.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's move to the cafeteria
kitchen! We
already have a chocolate
pen waiting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Neither of you considered the
possibility
that I might not know what
dream to write?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! We've been cheering you
on as
you chase your dream for years
now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Write that French name nice and big!
Oh, and if
they're a bit tricky to spell—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I got this. ♪ Those were the very
first
words I learned how to write.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
As above:
So I'll write them nice and big:
"Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe"!
